text:
riley: kicking off a scoped access scrub for KMS cross-project bindings today at 10:30 PT. goal: identify cross-account principals, tag evidence, and avoid any automatic revokes. we only create owner validation tickets.
han: A few constraints: 1) don't touch SAs used by rolling jobs; 2) skip keys with active rotation in the last 30d; 3) mark external domains (not @redwood) as high-risk.
riley: agree. pipeline will tag rotation_recent, cron_svc, and external_principal. we'll annotate tickets with raw last_use snippets.
devsec-bot: recert-scan started 2026-06-11T17:30:12Z. scanning IAM, KMS grants, and service-account roles. progress pings will be posted here.
marta: suggestion: include the last 3 actors for each key so owners can see whether an external system is driving use. e.g. last_actor_chain = [svc-a@proj, user-b@redwood, ext-app@vendor].
han: good. also surface if key has been used for 'sign' vs 'decrypt' since misuse patterns differ.
ops-oncall: heads-up — mass owner emails usually spike oncall noise. please rate-limit to 40/hr and add header X-Notify-Policy:quiet for known oncall aliases.
riley: copy. we'll add rate-limit and X-Notify-Policy. plan: 1) collect data 2) open owner-evidence tickets with tags + last-3-actors 3) 72h response window 4) escalate to ops-oncall for manual remediation if ownerless.
devsec-bot: collection finished 2026-06-11T17:37:30Z. summary: 3,210 IAM entries, 89 KMS grants, 29 cross-project principals, 57 potential ownerless items. creating 86 tickets.
han: quick query for logs (stackdriver) to get last N decrypts per key:
```
fetch kms_key
| filter protoPayload.methodName contains "Decrypt"
| parse protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail as actor
| stats latest(timestamp) as last_use, collect(actor)[-3] as last_3_actors by resource.labels.key_name
| sort last_use asc
```
use this to prioritize keys with oldest activity.
marta: i'll take the top 10 external-principal keys and reach out to partner-eng to confirm integrations before tickets go out.
ops-oncall: i'll prepare a short remediation playbook for oncall so manual revokes are safe (check for rotation, dependent services, and emergency rollback steps).
riley: thanks. i'll post ticket summary in #triage tomorrow AM and tag owners. also adding runbook link: /runbooks/access-recert/kms-crossproj.md.
devsec-bot: tickets created: recert-20260611-86. tags: external_principal(29), rotation_recent(12), cron_svc(9).
riley: nice work. after owner responses we'll run a dry-run revoke report and share here before any manual action. :thumbsup:
